task: English source sentence to meaning-preserving Roman-script Hinglish in a selected persona voice

split_policy: Split by source_id; all three persona targets for a source stay in one split. OOD and minimal_pairs are separate evaluation-only sets.

sources.source: I don't trust someone who changes their story every time.

must_keep: Preserve who does what, the intent, and any condition, negation or commitment.
